name: Flash-frame cut
visual_intent: A turning point: the scenes swap under one or two frames of flash that then decays, so a hard cut lands as an event instead of a jump.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low (<5MB); opacity on one full-frame div (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: One overlay div per flash, opaque for `hold` frames from the cue, scenes cut under it 1 ms later, opacity decays with power2.out, then hidden. shape 'radial' sets a radial-gradient burst centred on an incoming element measured with Studio.boxAt. preDim darkens the outgoing scene first. Throws on a fourth flash within one second of the same timeline (WCAG 2.3.1).
runtime_api: Studio.fx.flash(tl, outScene, inScene, at, {color, shape, center, x, y, hold, decay, preDim, dimTo})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html (opaque on the cut, scenes swapped under it, decay, cleanup, radial burst, the WCAG guard, seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; frame review tests/reference-derived/flash-and-container/qa/report.json (0 errors). Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
